communication_data_handoff.title: Streamline Intermediate Handoff Payloads to Field-Specific Deltas
communication_data_handoff.observed_problem: Workflow passes full document and global context payloads across sequential agent boundaries (31 detected handoff edges). Intermediate agents receive unneeded upstream metadata, inflating prompt token consumption across every stage.
communication_data_handoff.proposed_solution: Replace raw full-state serialization with typed, field-specific projection schemas. Each agent receives strictly its declared input requirements and emits only newly computed attributes.

expected_benefit.quality_impact: Reduces context dilution and LLM attention distraction.

tradeoffs_and_risks.token_cost_tradeoff: 20-25% reduction in cumulative workflow token volume.

model_selection.title: Route intake_agent to openai/gpt-oss-20b (JEV Agent 2 Recommendation; requires validation)
model_selection.observed_problem: JEV 2-Agent LangGraph evaluation classified 'intake_agent' as Task=Low, Prompt=Medium, Tokens=Low. Assigning the baseline 'openai/gpt-oss-120b' introduces unnecessary compute cost; JEV Agent 2 selected 'openai/gpt-oss-20b' among eligible Groq models.

selected_model_metadata.metadata_source: Groq model documentation; max input derived; qualitative ratings are project heuristics

jev_agent2_recommendation.reason: Selected from the deterministically eligible general-purpose candidates. Role=general_purpose_reasoning; reasoning=High; instruction-following=High; context-window=131072; tool-calling=True.

model_selection.proposed_solution: Switch 'intake_agent' from 'openai/gpt-oss-120b' to 'openai/gpt-oss-20b' per the 2-agent JEV LangGraph workflow (Agent 2 recommendation) with structured schema output validation.

expected_benefit.quality_impact: Requires shadow validation against baseline traces to confirm behavioral equivalence.

tradeoffs_and_risks.latency_tradeoff: Substantial speedup on first-stage document intake.
tradeoffs_and_risks.token_cost_tradeoff: ~50.0% API pricing reduction vs. 'openai/gpt-oss-120b' based on Groq catalog rates.
tradeoffs_and_risks.output_quality_risk: Moderate (compact model recommended by JEV Agent 2 requires empirical shadow validation against baseline traces).
